headline: Colombia Ministry of Finance to Launch Tokenized Sovereign Bond Framework
summary: Colombia's Ministry of Finance announced a proposal to launch tokenized sovereign bonds to expand public debt markets. The framework includes restructuring market-maker evaluations, drawing on tokenized debt structures pioneered in Hong Kong.
why: Tokenized sovereign debt issuances utilize distributed ledger systems to reduce secondary market clearing costs and widen retail fixed-income access.

impacts.name: Colombia
impacts.why: Colombia's Finance Ministry introduced tokenized bond infrastructure to modernize public debt markets.
